decision.observation: Spool room's spool is definite scenery; all abilities (X, S harpoon, D needolin) are inert on it. The only confirmed connections are left along the cobblestone and the bottom-right edge to the horned-shell cave. HUD shows crest/needle icons. Q (Crest) is a completely untested binding and may reveal abilities or equipment.
decision.hypothesis: Pressing Q opens the Crest/ability menu; it may show usable abilities or gear that unlock a blocked mechanism (e.g., the woven spools).
